claims: Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor at the 2026 Oscars for his dual role in Sinners.
The 98th Academy Awards took place on March 15, 2026.
Michael B. Jordan secured his first Oscar win for his role as twins in Ryan Coogler's vampire movie Sinners.
Timothée Chalamet was nominated for Best Actor at the 2026 Oscars for Marty Supreme.
Leonardo DiCaprio was nominated for Best Actor at the 2026 Oscars for Paul Thomas Anderson’s One Battle After Another.
Ethan Hawke received a nomination for Best Actor at the 2026 Oscars for Blue Moon.
Wagner Moura was nominated for Best Actor at the 2026 Oscars for The Secret Agent.
Wagner Moura was the first Brazilian nominated for Best Actor.
